text:
matt: Holding the release window. CI preflight failed on artifact metadata mismatch — deploy-bot aborting promote.
sophie: Paste the preflight output?
matt: Sure:
```
[deploy-bot] HEAD https://artifacts.internal/releases/release-2026-03-21.tar.gz -> 200
[deploy-bot] content-length: 12345678
[deploy-bot] x-artifact-checksum: sha256:aa11bb22 (expected)
[deploy-bot] fetched blob checksum computed=sha256:cc33dd44 -> mismatch
[deploy-bot] meta: content-encoding header missing, expected gzip
[deploy-bot] promote aborted: artifact-meta-mismatch attempts=3
```
deploy-bot: promote blocked (reason=artifact-meta-mismatch). Auto-promote suspended for R-2026-03-21-10.
ops: We had an agent that uploaded without gzip; looks like a CI job changed the tar creation step. Investigating.
andrew: Can we pin to current running digest (sha256:99ee77) and keep rollout paused? That buys time to fix upload and re-run checksum.
sophie: +1 pin and hold. If we force-promote now we risk serving uncompressed payloads and breaking edge proxies.
matt: Okay doing: `/deploybot suspend R-2026-03-21-10` -> suspended. Routing flipped to sha256:99ee77 for 45m. I'll draft the blurb for #release-announcements: "Short delay: artifact metadata mismatch in staging preflight; pinned previous image while we verify reupload; ETA ~30m."
ops: Quick fix plan: update CI pack step to include `tar -czf` and re-run artifact publish. I'll kick a re-publish and compute sha256.
andrew: Also add a preflight check for content-encoding and checksum before promote — don't want this recurring.
security-bot: Note: if uncompressed artifacts were served briefly, some CDNs might cache uncompressed variants. Recommend CDN purge once reupload verified.
sophie: Good catch. ops, can you reupload and then send the new digest here?
ops: Reuploading now with `tar -czf release-2026-03-21.tar.gz ./build && gsutil cp release-2026-03-21.tar.gz gs://artifacts/releases/`
ops: Reupload complete. New sha256=aa11bb22 verified locally. Content-encoding: gzip present.
deploy-bot: artifact re-verified: HEAD -> 200, content-encoding=gzip, sha256=aa11bb22. Pre-promote smoke queued.
andrew: Running quick smoke on the reuploaded artifact.
sophie: Smoke green on pinned digest. Waiting on smoke for new artifact.
andrew: New artifact smoke passed. No migrations. Approving manual promote.
matt: Permit manual promote. `/deploybot promote --manual R-2026-03-21-10` accepted. Rolling update policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
security-bot: CDN purge triggered for keys releases/release-2026-03-21/* to clear any uncompressed cached objects.
sophie: Follow-ups: 1) CI preflight check for content-encoding + checksum (ticket PLAT-1512), 2) add unit test to packaging step to ensure gzip applied, 3) monitor artifact checksum mismatch alerts.
matt: Thanks everyone. I'll update release notes and close the window after rollout completes. :white_check_mark:
